{{Quote|&hellip;Ben...|General Mohc calls Ben to step forward for an award|<ref name="SftE" />}}
'''Ben''' was a member of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who trained as a [[Cadet/Legends|cadet]] at the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] [[Carida Academy/Legends|of Carida]], located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carida/Legends|Carida]]. Ben joined the academy<ref name="SftE" /> during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]],<ref name="Reader Date 1">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]'', and by extension the [[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire (audio drama)|audio adaption]], at a date of [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. The text mentions that the cadets graduating have spent four years at the academy. Using simple math, it can be deduced that Ben joined the academy at a date of [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]].</ref> and graduated<ref name="SftE" /> during [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="Reader Date 2">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]'', and by extension the [[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire (audio drama)|audio adaption]], at a date of [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].</ref> During Ben's graduation, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Rom Mohc]] called Ben's name to present the cadet with a special award of valor and merit.<ref name="SftE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ben was first mentioned in the [[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire (audio drama)|audio adaption]] of the novella ''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]'', which was released in [[1997]]. As the character's name is only given in spoken dialogue from the audio adaption, the actual spelling of the character's name cannot be determined. "Ben" is actually the character's last name. The first part of their name is obscured by another character speaking, making it impossible to discern.
